prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1406; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck and low back pain and muscle stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. Over the course of 25 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, spinal mobilization, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, progressing in a typical pattern with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Examination revealed reduced cervical and lumbar range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to the neck or low back. Billed services reflect single charges for each visit without duplication. Patient was discharged with a home program and instructed to return if symptoms recur. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
